# Proxiedmail

ProxiedMail offers privacy-focused email services, including automatic creation of proxy emails and receiving emails via webhooks.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/proxiedmail/.

## Actions

- **Create webhook receiver**: Create a webhook receiver for incoming email callbacks.
- **Get API Token**: Retrieve a permanent api token.
- **List proxy bindings** (read-only): Fetch a list of proxy bindings.
- **Update Proxy Binding**: Update an existing proxy binding.
